$comment: Register of in-tree forks of third-party crates (SUP-005). A path / [patch] fork is invisible
to cargo update, Dependabot, cargo-audit and cargo-deny, so this file is what lets CI watch the
upstream crate instead: scripts/internal/vendored-fork-drift.mjs (weekly, Vendored Forks
workflow) compares each entry against crates.io, the upstream repo and OSV/RustSec, and
scripts/internal/check-vendored-forks.mjs keeps this file in sync with the vendored dirs.
base_*     = the upstream release/commit the fork was copied from. Only changes on a re-base.
reviewed_* = how far upstream has been reviewed. After reading new upstream commits/releases
(and porting any fix that matters), bump these to acknowledge them; the drift job
only reports what lies beyond. Default: equal to base_*.
acknowledged_advisories = advisory ids (RUSTSEC-/GHSA-) against the upstream base version that
were checked and do not apply to the fork (fixed locally, code path removed). Each

forks.parses: RFB/VNC server messages and framebuffer encodings (Raw, CopyRect, Tight, ZRLE, TRLE, cursor)
forks.base_commit_note: upstream publishes no git tags; this is the commit that bumped Cargo.toml to 0.5.3

deltas.summary: VeNCrypt 0.2 (RFB security type 19) negotiation over rustls behind the vencrypt feature
Encoding-correct, bounded RFB cut-text (Latin-1/UTF-8, 16 MiB ServerCutText cap)
Hostile-server hardening: no server-reachable panics, bounded allocations, catch_unwind task boundary, seeded fuzz tests
Spec-conformant TRLE decoder (RFC 6143 7.7.5): no ZRLE length prefix, 16x16 tiles, palette-reuse subencodings 127/129
VncEvent::Error carries the typed Arc<VncError> instead of rendered text

Upstream 0.6.0 security/robustness fixes ported onto the 0.5.3 base: checked SecurityResult/SecurityType handshake, PixelFormat validation, rects bound to negotiated encodings and the framebuffer, cancellable decoder/bridge I/O, non-deadlocking input()

16-bit high colour: RGB565 PixelFormat, full-PIXEL Tight TPIXELs (fill/copy/palette/gradient), cursor shapes decoded to RGBA8888 for every true-colour format; Tight JPEG-quality / compression-level pseudo-encodings

ExtendedDesktopSize pseudo-encoding (-308) with a bounded layout parser (<=16 screens, accepted sizes <=8192), DesktopLayout/DesktopLayoutUnsupported events, a validated SetDesktopSize client message (251), and refresh requests that follow the current framebuffer size
Tight 24-bit TPIXELs serialised in the negotiated byte order with an opaque alpha lane for every filter (upstream: always little-endian, gradient alpha 0)
VeNCrypt CA PEM bundles parsed with rustls-pki-types (CertificateDer::pem_slice_iter) instead of the unmaintained rustls-pemfile (RUSTSEC-2025-0134)

forks.parses: RDP audio output virtual channel PDUs (MS-RDPEA)

deltas.summary: RdpsndClientHandler::wave receives the concrete negotiated AudioFormat instead of an index
accepts_format hook: echo server-chosen compressed formats (ADPCM/Opus) verbatim, deterministic order

Upstream fixes ported after 0.9.0: malformed server PDUs (incl. encrypted waves) are dropped instead of ending the session, CryptKey/WaveEncrypt keep the channel alive, get_format indexes the client list

Pre-v8 SNDC_WAVE playback ported from upstream 2d9a9bf1: WaveInfo + bare Wave reassembled via an ExpectingWave state and confirmed (short payload / bad wFormatNo confirmed unplayed); WavePdu is WaveInfo-only plus a new WaveDataPdu
Training Confirm echoes the server's wPackSize (whole PDU size) instead of the data length, so GNOME Remote Desktop sends audio; port of unreleased upstream f86e3c49 (IronRDP#2294)

forks.parses: RDP PDUs from RDP servers (connection sequence, Share Control/Data headers, capability sets, fast-path/slow-path output)

deltas.summary: Accept the 6-byte Share Control Header (shareId optional) so xrdp's header-only Deactivate All PDU no longer ends the session; port of unreleased upstream d4b728a1d40b (IronRDP#1719)

Upstream robustness fixes ported after 0.9.0 (reviewed up to 62246b36): undersized TPKT/Fast-Path frame lengths refused (33506e61), zero-length empty Update/Pointer PDUs and VRDP's under-declared Server Font Map accepted while other under-declared Data PDUs stay refused (33506e61, 9b04c90c, e496b7b8), unknown server GCC user-data blocks skipped (629a8024), unknown multitransport flag and echoed protocol bits retained (e8a75797, 9af99317), ERRINFO_SERVER_SHUTDOWN/REBOOT decoded (d2bb7376), auto-reconnect random redacted from Debug (d0948faa)

Licensing hardening ported after 0.11.0 (reviewed up to 5c4dcfa7): RSA moduli below 512 bits refused instead of a modpow panic on a hostile server's zero modulus (c3386173, IronRDP#2225); licensing secrets, client user/machine names and certificate material withheld from Debug (5c4dcfa7, IronRDP#2344)

forks.parses: RDPDR device-redirection PDUs from RDP servers (server announce, capabilities, drive/printer/smartcard I/O requests)

deltas.summary: Drive Device Announce carries the drive name (first 7 valid ASCII characters, DRIVE fallback) in PreferredDosName instead of the literal "ignored", so xrdp mounts drives under their names; port of the unreleased upstream PreferredDosName::for_drive from 161409e18dd1 (IronRDP#1566), keeping 0.7.0's UTF-8 DeviceData (see IronRDP#2075)
deltas.upstream_status: Fixed on upstream master (161409e), unreleased; xrdp data point and release request posted on IronRDP#2075 on 2026-10-06

deltas.summary: Drive Device Announce DeviceData as null-terminated 8-bit characters with the characters Windows refuses (MS-RDPEFS 2.2.1.3), NUL and non-ASCII replaced by _, instead of raw UTF-8; port of unreleased upstream 4cd9d4506 (IronRDP#2342), which closed IronRDP#2075
deltas.upstream_status: Fixed on upstream master (4cd9d4506, 2026-11-03), unreleased; with it master has both deltas, so the fork retires on the next ironrdp-rdpdr release

deltas.summary: Drive I/O requests the crate does not implement (IRP_MJ_SET_VOLUME_INFORMATION, an unsupported information class in Set Information / Query Volume Information / Query Directory, an undescribed IRP_MJ_DIRECTORY_CONTROL minor function) are completed with STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED (Length echoed) or STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL instead of a decode error that ends the RDP session; port of upstream 0f9154d2 (IronRDP#2174) adapted to 0.7.0
deltas.upstream_status: Released upstream in ironrdp-rdpdr 0.9.0 (0f9154d2 predates the release); goes away with the IronRDP upgrade (#5117)

forks.parses: serial-port configuration (termios) and raw byte I/O with attached serial devices

deltas.summary: macOS/iOS: fall back to a termios speed when the IOSSIOSPEED ioctl is rejected (ENOTTY/ENOTSUP/EOPNOTSUPP) for a standard rate, so pseudo-terminals and drivers without custom-speed support can be opened

forks.parses: PROXY protocol v1 headers and FTP control/data traffic on the embedded FTP server's per-session loopback listeners (relay-opened connections only, #4100)
forks.base_commit_note: upstream tag libunftp-0.24.0 (the crates.io release commit, re-based 2026-11-09, #5119)

deltas.summary: Server::listen_with_listener (serve on a caller-bound TcpListener, all listener modes) and ServerBuilder::proxy_protocol_peer_filter (PROXY-mode accept filter on the peer address, applied before the header is read), so termiHub's relay is the only process its loopback listener serves
deltas.upstream_status: Proposed 2026-10-06 as libunftp#581 (still open 2026-11-09); the pull request (patch in vendor/libunftp/UPSTREAM.md) waits for maintainer feedback on the direction
